❤️‍🩹 At the end of 2023 we were told we were obese by the hospital. 

If we wanted their help to get pregnant and potentially have IVF we needed to get our BMIs lowered and show we were prioritsing our health, fast forward to summer of 2026, we ran 12k on holiday for fun. We're both training for a half marathon in 3 weeks time and launching our first 5k run event together on the 10th October. 
Were completely different people and never felt better for it.

So as difficult as it was hearing the Dr tell us we had to make a change. It was also the biggest reset for us mentally, physically and emotionally. 

Follow @emilylucyrajch & @_timms__ for more healthy lifestyle content and our fertility journey to start a family.

Wild video shows Democratic congressional candidate Kirill Basin involved in an unhinged beach brawl in Maui after allegedly threatening beachgoers with a knife.

Officials say the incident began when a 61-year-old man asked Basin to lower the volume of his music. According to reports, Basin then threatened the man by implying he had a firearm and would shoot the man's wife.

Footage shows Basin making threats to people on the beach, including, “I’ll put you in the f*****g ground,” before a bystander steps in to try to defuse the situation. The confrontation turns violent and ends with Basin appearing to be knocked unconscious on the ground.

Police arrested the 40-year-old and charged him with two counts of first-degree terroristic threatening.

Basin, who was running against Rep. Jill Tokuda for Hawaii's 2nd Congressional District, was held on $1 million bail.
